story.summaryEn:
LAP 20/51:
No change in positions, but there is to the cars around us. 
NOR is now the car ahead of Pierre, +2.9s up the road. Franco has ANT +3.4s behind.
detailZh: 第20圈（共51圈）：我们的位置没有变化，但周围的车辆发生了变化。诺里斯（NOR）现在是皮埃尔（Pierre）前方的车辆，领先2.9秒。弗朗哥（Franco）落后安特（ANT）3.4秒。
detailEn:
LAP 20/51:
No change in positions, but there is to the cars around us. 
NOR is now the car ahead of Pierre, +2.9s up the road. Franco has ANT +3.4s behind.
